newsitem.title: GERMANY: Shares in Germany's GBH on offer at 28.50 marks.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Germany's GBH on offer at 28.50 marks.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Grundstuecks- und Baugesellschaft AG, Heidenheim (GBH) will be offered to the public at 28.50 marks apiece from October 2-7, a group led by Baden Wuerttembergische Bank AG said on Monday.

The shares, with a five mark nominal value, will be issued as part of a capital increase to 25 million marks nominal from 20 million marks. The issue of one million shares should raise 28.5 million marks, BW Bank said in a statement.
The shares are expected to be listed on the regulated market of the Baden-Wuerttemberg stock exchange on October 11.
